yadyapi jīvabhedānāmutpattirutpattiprakaraṇe vistareṇa varṇiteti
na punaḥ praśnārhā tathāpi kariṣyamāṇasyākṣepasyotthānāya viśeṣabubhutsayā
ca punaḥ praśno bodhyaḥ

ata eva vasiṣṭhaḥ s'mkṣipya tatsamādhiṃ pratijānīte - utpadyante
ityādidvābhyām

tasyaiva samyagahaṃbhāvena sphuraṇaṃ ghanatāmetya prāpya sā ghanataiva mano
jīvopādhiścetyāśayenāha - mana iti

paritaḥ kacat svaprakāśamapi
citsvarūpaṃ parāgdṛṣṭyā dṛśyamānaṃ śūnyaṃ
riktaghaṭodarasadṛśamevāvabhāsate

tadavasthayā sthitaṃ tādṛgrūpameva
sarvajanadṛśyaṃ tatprasiddhamākāśamityucyata ityarthaḥ

itthaṃ copādhyutpattermithyātve tatprayuktā jīvotpattiḥ sutarāṃ
mithyetyāśayenāha - cittamātreti

madhye āntarālikadaśāyāṃ sthitā
mokṣāya yatamānā api punaḥpunarvighnaiḥ skhalanti
kva tarhi śāstrādhikāraprayojakaṃ vairāgyaṃ sulabhaṃ tānāha - bhuvīti

tāsāṃ narajātīnāṃ
madhye tāmasīnāṃ śāstrānadhikārādupadeśayogyā
rājasasāttvikīrdvicatvāriṃśe sarge jīvāvataraṇakramavarṇane
pravakṣyāmītyarthaḥ

yadamṛtaṃ brahma taccidābhāsaṃ jīvarūpaṃ yathā jātaṃ tadapi tatraiva
vakṣyāmītyarthaḥ

saumye niścale'bdhau calatāṃ taraṅgāṇāṃ
calatā cāñcalyamiva sattaikadeśato jīvabhāvena spando yathā ghanatāmeti tathā
tadapi tatraiva pravakṣyāmītyarthaḥ

akhaṇḍapūrṇasattaikarase
brahmaṇi sattaikadeśasya spandasya cāsaṃbhāvyatvāditi rāmaḥ śaṅkate -
anantasyeti

jīvabrahmaikyasya vāstavasya
vyutpādanāyāyamutpattyekadeśaspandādivyavahāraḥ śāstre kalpitaḥ ato na
vastuvṛttyāśrayeṇa tasyāṃ virodha udbhāvanīya ityāśayena vasiṣṭha
uttaramāha - tena jātamityādinā

yadi tatra na saṃbhavanti tarhi jagatāmanyadeva mūlaṃ kalpyatāṃ tatrāha - taṃ
vineti

hetukārye
kramaśabdārthau vyavahārajā uktayaśca kutastyā iti vipariṇamyate

ekasyaiva dīpasya māyayā dvidhā svarūpanirmāṇakriyāśaktau
yadādhikyamatiśayastadeva janyaṃ janakamiti dvidhā bhāsata ityarthaḥ

śabdārthaviklavo nāmarūpavyavahāraśramaḥ uktau vāṅmātre'sti na deve
paramātmanyasti

yataḥ pramitau
paricchede sati bhinnatā syādityarthaḥ

tajjayā kriyāśaktijanyayaiva manaḥśaktyā svataḥ svabhāvata eva saṃjñā
nāmavibhāgo'pi pravartate

ekasyāpyajñānasya
saṃśayabhedaiḥ saha bahutvavivakṣayā tattadajñānasaṃkṣaye iti vīpsoktiḥ

kudṛṣṭyā ajñānadūṣitadṛṣṭyā
yadidamakhilaṃ jagadātataṃ sarvato vistṛtaṃ bhāti tasya sarvasya sahājñānena
nāśe sati nirmaladarpaṇābhe avitathe paramārthabhūte paramapade nirmale
avitathaṃ tadeva bhaviṣyati sthāsyati
